message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/capstonemaster && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"suite/regress/invalid_read_in_print_operand.c","function":"main","line":4,"var":"BINARY","code":"#define BINARY \"\\x3b\\x30\\x62\\x93\\x5d\\x61\\x03\\xe8\"","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are embedded as the disassembly input; the first byte selects x86-64 mode and the remaining bytes become the instruction stream."},
  {"step":2,"file":"suite/regress/invalid_read_in_print_operand.c","function":"main","line":11,"var":"(uint8_t *)BINARY","code":"cs_disasm(handle, (uint8_t *)BINARY, sizeof(BINARY) - 1, 0x1000, 0, &insn);","note":"The raw bytes are passed directly into Capstone's disassembler, so parsing and printing are driven entirely by the crafted input."},
  {"step":3,"file":"arch/X86/X86Module.c","function":"<global>","line":21,"var":"ud->printer","code":"ud->printer = X86_Intel_printInst;","note":"For x86 Intel syntax, Capstone routes decoded instructions to the Intel printer, which is the vulnerable sink path."},
  {"step":4,"file":"arch/X86/X86IntelInstPrinter.c","function":"X86_Intel_printInst","line":769,"var":"MI->assembly[0]","code":"if (MI->assembly[0]) { strncpy(O->buffer, MI->assembly, sizeof(O->buffer)); return; }","note":"If LLVM leaves a preformatted assembly string, it is copied into the output buffer; otherwise Capstone falls through to instruction-specific formatting."},
  {"step":5,"file":"arch/X86/X86IntelInstPrinter.c","function":"X86_Intel_printInst","line":779,"var":"printInstruction(MI, O, Info)","code":"printInstruction(MI, O, Info);","note":"The crafted instruction reaches the generic x86 printer, which formats operands and immediates using helper routines that may read uninitialized state."},
  {"step":6,"file":"arch/X86/X86IntelInstPrinter.c","function":"printPCRelImm","line":804,"var":"imm","code":"int64_t imm = MCOperand_getImm(Op) + MI->flat_insn->size + MI->address;","note":"The vulnerable hypothesis is that operand-printing for this instruction reads an uninitialized or invalid operand value while computing a PC-relative immediate, leading to the MSan use-of-uninitialized-value crash reported in X86_Intel_printInst."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p)
PY
bash ./submit.sh /tmp/poc.bin /workspace/candidate_trace.json; echo SUBMIT_EXIT:$?` executed with exit code 0.
